notes: rings are [[x, z], ...] in the game frame, open (last vertex not repeated), simplified to about 0.1 m; outer rings anticlockwise and holes clockwise seen from above with north up (anticlockwise in E, N, so the shoelace sum over x, z is negative for an outer ring); 'holes' flags each ring of a list, parallel to it. land is the island land polygon with its 0.5 m stair steps corner-cut (within 0.16 m of the source; it includes most of the causeway); causeway is the traced neck; banks are the far-bank land of the garden; open_water is water with no canopy over it; shoreline is the shore beneath the canopy.
